subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is a young female character with short orange hair, black horn accessories, wearing an orange and white short kimono with a red rope obi, bandages on her right leg, and wooden sandals, as seen in <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is a young female character with short light blue hair, wearing a black, white, and blue tight combat suit with gold accents and black thigh-high boots, as seen in <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is a young female character with blonde ponytail and a black bow, wearing a blue, white, and gold knight uniform with white tight pants and boots, as seen in <Picture 3>.
<Subject 4> is a fantasy fusion environment featuring a stone arena floor, cherry blossom petals floating in the air, distant castle walls, and a bright sky, combining elements from all reference images.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second high-impact 2D anime beat-synced MV featuring 20 rapid cuts of <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, and <Subject 3> interacting dynamically in the preserved environment <Subject 4>. The visual arc alternates between five specific physical bump interactions and fifteen highly sensual solo or duo poses, enhanced by decorative color blocks, halftone patterns, and geometric graphic accents, synced to a fast electronic beat without any on-screen text. Color palette: orange, blue, white, black, and gold.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]–[Shot 20]): fully_preserved - orange hair, horn accessories, orange and white kimono, red rope obi, leg bandages, and wooden sandals remain consistent.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]–[Shot 20]): fully_preserved - light blue hair, black white and blue combat suit, gold accents, and black thigh-high boots remain consistent.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]–[Shot 20]): fully_preserved - blonde ponytail, black bow, blue white and gold knight uniform, white tight pants, and boots remain consistent.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1]–[Shot 20]): fully_preserved - stone arena floor, floating cherry blossom petals, distant castle walls, and bright sky maintain consistent spatial and lighting relationships.

detailed_description:
High-end cel-shaded anime fashion illustration with dynamic sensual aesthetics, razor-clean line art, luminous eyes, graphic shadow shapes, and kinetic camera impact. The color palette derives from orange, blue, white, black, and gold, enhanced by decorative color blocks, halftone patterns, and geometric graphic accents.
[Shot 1] Extreme close-up. <Subject 1> arches her back in a sensual pose, an orange color block sliding behind her. Camera shutter click.
[Shot 2] At 00:00.750, medium shot. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> perform a playful chest bump, a pink halftone pattern overlaying the background. Soft cloth snap.
[Shot 3] At 00:01.500, full-body shot. <Subject 3> strikes a confident sensual pose, framed by geometric gold lines. Whip-pan whoosh.
[Shot 4] At 00:02.250, medium shot. <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> lean their shoulders together in a sharp shoulder bump, blue graphic shards scattering. Heavy bass thud.
[Shot 5] At 00:03.000, medium close-up. <Subject 1> traces her collarbone, a white ink wipe revealing a new angle. Subtle bass thud.
[Shot 6] At 00:03.750, extreme close-up. <Subject 1> and <Subject 3> press their foreheads together in an intense forehead bump, eyes locked. Shutter click.
[Shot 7] At 00:04.500, low-angle shot. <Subject 2> lifts one leg in a sensual stance, black and gold color blocks framing the shot. Synth hit.
[Shot 8] At 00:05.250, medium shot. <Subject 2> and <Subject 1> perform a sensual pelvic side bump, their hips grinding slightly. Pop sound.
[Shot 9] At 00:06.000, medium shot. <Subject 3> looks over her shoulder, a blue halftone gradient fading in the background. Whoosh.
[Shot 10] At 00:06.750, medium shot from behind. <Subject 3> and <Subject 2> execute a rhythmic hip bump, their buttocks pressing firmly. Cloth snap.
[Shot 11] At 00:07.500, extreme close-up. <Subject 1> bites her finger lightly, orange geometric accents flashing. Screen shake.
[Shot 12] At 00:08.250, medium shot. <Subject 2> arches her back, a white color block wiping across the screen. Bass drop.
[Shot 13] At 00:09.000, close-up. <Subject 3> rests her chin on her hand, gold halftone dots pulsing. Shutter click.
[Shot 14] At 00:09.750, full-body shot. <Subject 1> shifts her weight, highlighting her bandaged leg, blue graphic lines tracing her silhouette. Soft thud.
[Shot 15] At 00:10.500, medium close-up. <Subject 2> licks her lips slowly, black and orange color blocks intersecting. Synth hit.
[Shot 16] At 00:11.250, medium shot. <Subject 3> wraps her arms around herself, a white ink transition revealing her profile. Whoosh.
[Shot 17] At 00:12.000, extreme close-up. <Subject 1> winks, gold star graphic accents popping. Shutter click.
[Shot 18] At 00:12.750, medium shot. <Subject 2> crosses her arms, blue halftone patterns swirling. Cloth snap.
[Shot 19] At 00:13.500, full-body shot. The trio stands in a staggered formation, each striking a highly alluring pose, surrounded by floating geometric shapes. Heavy bass thud.
[Shot 20] At 00:14.250, final heroic full-body pose. The three characters freeze in their most confident, sensual stance in <Subject 4>, eyes piercing the camera, framed by a massive gold color block. Final chord.

overall_soundscape:
Sparse, high-impact sound effects synced to 20 rapid cuts: shutter clicks, cloth snaps, bass thuds, whooshes, and soft body contact sounds. Strictly below music level.

non_diegetic_music:
A 132 BPM, 4/4 time signature fast electronic pop club track with heavy sensual undertones. Prominent synth bassline, crisp kick drums, non-semantic vocal chops. Builds dynamically, peaks at 00:07.500, resolves into a clean final chord at 00:15.000.
